test_scope.borrow_stop: Atomic BorrowFence generation/stop/last loan; 32-of-33 preallocated buffer cap and no post-stop mutation.
test_scope.kernel_negative: Existing isolated child drops its own effective CAP_NET_RAW then asserts real AF_PACKET socket syscall EPERM=1 and typed PermissionDenied with no UDP transport fallback.
test_scope.kernel_conditional: Test-only real recvmmsg called solely on protocol=0 inactive AF_PACKET FD if effective CAP_NET_RAW permits open; otherwise test returns after explicit typed EPERM. Positive raw FD open, actual packet reception, or CAP_NET_RAW availability is NOT established by 60/60.
test_scope.physical_safety: No bind, interface attach, outgoing traffic, promiscuity, ambient capture, packet logging, Go V4 dispatch, or live raw RX.
